text:
Sara: Quick sync — customer pilot (Acme) kicks off next week. Need final acceptance criteria for batching/caching/quant recommendations + eval-alert gating. Can we lock these today?
Rajesh: +1. Propose measurable success:
- latency p50 <= 120ms, p99 <= 400ms
- end-to-end cost reduction >= 20% vs baseline
- cache hit rate >= 30% on prefix traffic
- quantized variant quality delta (BLEU/ROUGE/whatever) <= 1.5% absolute drop
Lina: For eval-alerts: thresholding on both utility and distribution drift. Suggest:
```
eval_alerts: {
  metric: "task_accuracy",
  baseline: 0.87,
  alert_if_drop_pct: 2.0,
  window_minutes: 60,
  min_samples: 100
}
```
Lina: Also add a separate alert for embedding drift (cosine mean shift > 0.015) — ops should see this before rollout to more hosts.
Tyler: Ops/infra constraints: we can hit p50 easily with batching but p99 is sensitive to batch window. If customer wants p99 <= 400ms we must cap batch delay <= 5ms for tail-sensitive routes. That reduces batching efficiency.
Rajesh: Noted. Maybe make two tiers in pilot: 
- batch-aggressive: max delay 25ms (higher cost, better throughput)
- batch-tail-safe: max delay 5ms (p99 SLO)
Rajesh: Pilot should run both on separate routes to compare econ + quality.
Sam: From CS: Acme's acceptance: they need <2% hallucination increase on their prompts and a visible cost win. They specifically asked for a sample run where total monthly cost drops by at least 15% in staging.
Sara: OK we need to translate that into our gating: pass if (quality_drop <= 1.5%) AND (projected_cost_reduction >= 15%) AND (no eval_alerts fired in 72h window).
Lina: Small note on eval windows — 72h sometimes misses config regressions; add guard: auto-rollback if any critical alert triggers twice in 24h.
Tyler: Rollback plan: instant traffic switch to baseline model variant + disable batching config. I can add runbook.
deploy-bot: deploy started for pilot branch -> infra/pilot-2026-03-21 (status: queued) :gear:
Rajesh: One more: caching scope — prefix cache only for deterministic prompts and privacy-cleared routes. Need CS signoff from Acme on what routes are cacheable.
Sam: I'll get list from Acme today and confirm by EOD.
Sara: Decision summary:
- Two pilot routes: batch-aggressive & batch-tail-safe
- Acceptance gate: quality_drop <= 1.5% AND projected_cost_reduction >= 15% AND no eval_alerts (72h)
- Auto-rollback: any critical alert twice in 24h
- Cache only on approved routes; target cache_hit >= 30%
- Lina to land eval config, Tyler to add rollback runbook, Sam to get customer cache whitelist
Action items: @Lina (eval config + threshold PR), @Tyler (rollback runbook + SLO docs), @Sam (cacheable routes list), @Rajesh (pilot route configs & cost projections).
Sara: Thanks — will surface in pilot kickoff doc and notify Acme after we get the whitelist. :thumbsup:
